title: Water style parameters (W-01 authoring contract; W-02 renderer pending)
description: Data only. See docs/data_formats.md section 44 for units, formulas, transport rules and installation gating.

base_color.description: sRGB multiplier on native colour; white preserves it.

strength.description: Maximum depth tint blend; zero disables.

falloff.description: E-folding distance in water cells from low shore; not bathymetry.

width.description: Foam width in cells; zero disables.

strength.description: Foam intensity, or native brightness modulation in classicplus; zero disables.

amplitude.description: Dimensionless procedural normal amplitude; zero disables ambient perturbation.

speed.description: Normal animation speed multiplier; independent of wake simulation.

scale.description: Pattern frequency in inverse world pixels.

direction.description: World cell X/Y vector; normalise on use; zero vector disables flow.

strength.description: Pattern advection in cells per second; cosmetic only.

boat.description: Boat disturbance rate multiplier; zero disables.

player.description: Mobile disturbance rate multiplier; zero disables.

object.description: Falling/thrown item and effect disturbance multiplier; zero disables.

damping.description: Amplitude retention per 20 Hz simulation step.

reflection.description: Surface reflection blend; zero disables. Source and tier fallback pending W-02/W-07.

source.description: Local presentation clock only; no network time source.

rate.description: Elapsed seconds multiplier; zero freezes at offset.

offset.description: Elapsed clock offset in seconds; result modulo 3600.

fixed_time.description: Fixed presentation seconds modulo 3600; ignores rate and offset.

levels.description: Brightness levels; zero allows smooth style shading.

grain.description: World pixels per style pixel; native art remains nearest.
